candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'For wisdom is poured out like water, and glory faileth not before him for evermore' — wisdom-as-water. Tewahedo sapiential tradition (qǝne) cites this as the textual basis for the metaphor of teaching as water-pouring; the verse is recited in some Tewahedo monastic chants celebrating the founders' teaching ministry.
candidates.reviewer_notes: Curated PD interpretive summary representing the Ethiopian Tewahedo tradition's reading via 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition), Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71). Verify the summary still reflects the source's argument before promoting; substitute a verbatim quote from the NPNF / Charles dump where available, and where applicable cross-check the Andəmta homiletic tradition for resonance.

candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, and the spirit which gives insight, and the spirit of understanding and of might, and the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness' — the multi-spirit-on-the-Messiah list. Strikingly parallel to Isa 11:2's spirit-of-wisdom-and-understanding cluster, and to Rev 5:6's seven-spirits-of-God. Tewahedo pneumatology preserves this triadic resonance (Enoch / Isaiah / Revelation) in the eucharistic epiclesis prayers.

1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, and the spirit which gives insight, and the spirit of understanding and of might, and the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness' — the multi-spirit-on-the-Messiah list. Strikingly parallel to Isa 11:2's spirit-of-wisdom-and-understanding cluster, and to Rev 5:6's seven-spirits-of-God. Tewahedo pneumatology preserves this triadic resonance (Enoch / Isaiah / Revelation) in the eucharistic epiclesis prayers.
